window_casement_symbol.name: Window Symbol (Exterior Wall Casement)
window_casement_symbol.description: Parallel lines set into an exterior wall gap indicating the position and width of a window opening on a floor plan.

bedroom_zone.name: Bedroom (Double Bed Plan Symbol)
bedroom_zone.description: North-west room on the floor plan identified by the overhead plan symbol of a double bed and pillows.

interior_door_swing.name: Interior Hinged Door & Swing Arc
interior_door_swing.description: Straight door leaf and quarter-circle arc showing the doorway opening and the direction in which the door swings.

kitchen_fixtures.name: Kitchen Counter, Stove & Double Sink
kitchen_fixtures.description: South-west room featuring L-shaped cabinetry, a 4-plate hob symbol, and a double-bowl sink along the south window.

compass_north_rose.name: Compass Rose (North Point Indicator)
compass_north_rose.description: Directional symbol showing True North so cardinal orientations (N, S, E, W) and sunlight exposure of rooms can be determined.

bathroom_fixtures.name: Bathroom (Bathtub & Toilet Fixtures)
bathroom_fixtures.description: Tiled north-east room containing overhead architectural symbols for a bathtub and toilet.

lounge_living_area.name: Living Room / Lounge (L-Sofa & Table)
lounge_living_area.description: South-east living space accessed through the main exterior entry door.

bar_scale.name: Graphic Bar Scale (Linear Scale)
bar_scale.description: Alternating black-and-white segmented bar scale used to convert measured plan lengths into real-world dimensions even if the plan is resized.
